us.purpose: US-01 to US-22 smoke, scored by family (BEN-12, BEN-29): every user story has at least one case

chaos.purpose: every generated case with an injected fault, so every fault family is exercised (BEN-29, TST-06); the SEC-10 dependency-down matrix joins through its FAULT tags when its cases land

evil.purpose: the B6 security family, the suite to run with the evil provider (SEC-06, ADV-08)

full.purpose: the whole generated suite (PERD 48.1: at least 320 cases). The held-out layer is run by the benchmark owner, never here (INV-22)

g1.purpose: the G1 evidence run (BEN-05): every case covering US-01 or US-06, run twice through the public API and diffed by benchmark/replay. The open exclusion for the case that needs a Tushe-held fault is named in benchmark/replay/open_exclusions.json, not dropped here
